83 native body vertices moved by minimum halfspace correction, max1.369797mm. Original eye geometry/neutral transforms, base topology/UV and Multires levels remain.

existingOwnEyeLayerProvenance.notAuthoredByAevrynd: Original female scan topology/sculpt and eyeball mesh are Dan Ulrich CC0 asset data. This is an adapted source study, not an original character sculpt claim.
limitations: Neutral static only; gaze/blink/continuous motion not tested.
Source cornea contour and single-interface EEVEE refraction are approximate, not calibrated ocular optics.
Wetline/lacrimal tissue and full skin/hair/rig/oral/clothes/runtime still missing.
Pupil backing is a dark interior proxy behind a real iris aperture, not a retinal/lens simulation.
No body self-contact expansion; body geometry is exactly r29 and its existing scoped static evidence remains applicable.
Sampled unsigned gaps/residuals are not exact full-surface signed minima.
existingOwnEyeLayerProvenance.newOwnData: Triangle partitioning author code, annular iris/thickness geometry, dark pupil backing, radial iris texture and optical materials are authored locally. No downloaded iris image, eye program or other-engine runtime.
existingOwnEyeLayerProvenance.originalCC0Data: Female body, original eye exterior contour and source smooth normals derive from Dan Ulrich CC0 data.

opticalApproximation.approximation: One refracting interface. No aqueous/lens/retinal simulation or physical calibration.

colorWorkflow.scope: Actual saved PNG round-trip, allowing8-bit quantization of both inputs. Not a proof of biological iris color or human similarity.

newOwnWork: Profile-based correspondence, source-UV chart extraction, named coordinate-field mapping, photographic hair masks, regional roughness, calibrated shader and micron-scale procedural bump; no imported tool program.
coordinateRepresentation: B uses AFN32_RegisteredCC0UVW point-vector attribute, preserving native UV and all evaluated geometry. A used an incomplete extra UV field and is rejected.

calibration.purpose: Keep six reference skin sites at the prior average linear albedo while adding mapped anatomical pigment. This is explicit albedo colour calibration, not a lighting/exposure edit or a claim of measured human skin reflectance.

calibrationLimit: Six reference-site reflectance targets inherited from r11; not measured reflectance of this new subject, and not a claim of albedo capture. Source image contains photographic shading.
modifications: Continuous one-chart source coordinates extend through zero-weight vertices, preventing interpolation into undefined UV.
Scalp,brow and temple photo-hair regions masked to reference skin; no hair strands created or claimed.
UV-layer assignment in a diagnostic changed Multires evaluation by up to14.84um; retained B avoids that path using a generic point-vector field and verifies zero evaluated geometry changes.
limits: Approximate facial registration from a different subject/base, no exact skin capture.
Body outside registered head uses reference base reflectance only; no full body pigment detail claim.
Photographic source may contain baked shading, not a measured albedo scan.
Procedural microbump and coordinate-field sampling need engine-compatible baking.
No geometry/motion/contact/runtime changes or full-character acceptance.
